name: cronwatch/cronwatch
description: Cron and scheduled-job monitoring that lives inside your PHP app.

suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: For Cronwatch\Store\MysqlStore (MySQL 8.0.13 or MariaDB 10.6 and newer)
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: For Cronwatch\Store\PostgresStore and the pg_cron source (Cronwatch\Sources\PgCron)
suggest.ext-curl: The alert channels and Claude triage use it when loaded, and PHP's own streams otherwise
suggest.ext-openssl: For https alert channels and triage over PHP's streams, and a mysql:// URL's ssl-mode without an ssl-ca
suggest.ext-posix: The dashboard's development token directory is checked against the process's own user
suggest.laravel/framework: Laravel 12 or 13: the service provider is found by package discovery
suggest.symfony/scheduler: Symfony: every scheduled message is watched, and the check is added to the default schedule
suggest.symfony/messenger: Symfony: messages marked #[Cronwatch\Watch] are watched where a worker handles them
